style_rules.opening: Full-screen cobalt #1538B8, text #F5F7FF, muted #D4E2FF, accent #E6F69A. No large portrait column.
style_rules.student_scene: Pale lime #DCECA3, ink #14264F and muted #344B63. Large teacher line uses 65 percent opacity; student line gains emphasis.
style_rules.type: Centered Source Serif 4 title with italic second line; desktop 6rem to 10.5rem, phone 3.5rem to 6.8rem.
style_rules.graphics: Original cached contour islands and atlas points drawn on Canvas2D; pointer parallax, 24fps cap, DPR cap 1.5. No imported reference-site graphics.
style_rules.navigation: Separate floating masthead pills and a sticky contents dock. The identity selector is directly under the title.
style_rules.motion: Scene and typography transitions between 650ms and 800ms. Reduced motion and data saving render a static field; animation stops off screen.
style_rules.photography: Existing approved photographs follow the opening as a layered documentary spread; original links, captions and viewer controls retained.
style_rules.layout: 1296px content maximum, desktop gutters up to72px, phone gutters22px. Large serif section headings and a dark navy manifesto.
